text:
Eli (CS): Quick kickoff for Nebula reserved bring-up. Quota granted: 10 GPUs. Customer target: p95 < 130ms, p99 < 260ms. Need priming plan, autoscale numbers, chaos rehearsal, and a short customer-facing fallback note. Who takes what?
Sam (Infra): Ill own provisioning and priming. Plan: 8h prefix warm + KV seed. Priming command: `./bin/prime_pool --pool=nebula --hours=8 --mode=prefix`. Will post logs to `s3://infra-logs/nebula/prime/`.
Diane (SRE): Ill own monitoring and rollback playbook. Alerts proposed:
- `p95_chat_latency > 140ms` for 5m -> page
- `p99_chat_latency > 280ms` for 3m -> pager
- `error_rate > 0.4%` for 2m -> sev2
Ill add a lightweight runbook at `playbooks/dedicated/nebula-onboard.md`.
Ruth (PE): Ill run acceptance prompts and quality checks. Will prepare 600 mixed prompts and do embedding drift (mean cosine drop threshold 0.03). Also want an A/B sample vs hosted (1k reqs) during soak.
Eli (CS): Renewal heads-up: AM flagged renewal in 12 days. If soak fails we need an immediate exec note. Keep comms crisp.
Sam (Infra): Autoscale proposal: min=3, initial=5, max=12, step=2, cooldown=90s. For ramp window shorten to 45s. Add warmup ramp: hold 30% traffic for 10m then open.
Diane (SRE): Chaos rehearsal: induce one GPU restart and one rack-level packet-loss for 60s during ramp. If reconnection > 70s trigger automated traffic-shift. Fallback snippet: 
```
POST /v1/routing/shift
{"from":"nebula-pool","to":"hosted-fallback","timeout_s":90}
```
Eli (CS): Customer requested guaranteed fallback within 90s of detected tail spike. Make sure SLA language matches.
Ruth (PE): Prompt pack and baseline vectors uploaded: https://redwood.share/nebula/prompt-pack-v1.zip and s3://evals/nebula/baseline-v1.json. I'll ask for customer sign-off by Wed COB.
ops-bot: Canary job `ci/load-tests/nebula-reserved` scheduled: smoke 2026-05-28T14:00Z, ramp 16:00Z, soak 18:00Z (job id 84211).
Sam (Infra): Priming job started (job id 84212). Will post progress at 25/50/100%.
Diane (SRE): Ill create a minimal grafana panel and add it to the incident channel. Also adding an oncall checklist: contact list, rollback steps, and throttles.
Eli (CS): Action list: Sam=provision+prime, Diane=alerts+runbook+dashboard, Ruth=prompts+signoff, Eli=exec note & renewal update. Please confirm here by EOD. :thumbsup:
Sam (Infra): Confirmed.
Diane (SRE): Confirmed.
Ruth (PE): Confirmed, will ping customer for sign-off.
